name: Tidepool
summary: A liquid sign-in page: the whole background ripples as you type and a glowing drop follows you
about: A full sign-in page that sits on a live pool of water drawn on a canvas, with a frosted glass card and a headline that wobbles like it is under water. Drip, a glowing drop of light, follows your pointer and leaves a wake, swims over to watch the caret, and dives behind the frosted glass when you type a password. Good for a calm app, a startup or a creative brand that wants a login people remember.
how: The pool fades in, the headline letters drop in like rain and Drip falls into the water with a splash
Move the pointer: Drip follows with a stretchy, springy swim and leaves ripples behind it
Type in the email field: each key sends a ring through the field and a ripple across the pool while Drip watches the caret
On the password Drip dives behind the frosted glass with its eyes shut; Show password brings it back for a wink
Press Sign in: Drip pours itself into the button as the water rises, then splashes up on success or turns red and wobbles on an error
Fill demo types the working login, and Sign out brings the form back
